items.claim: Atlas Copco meddelte, at den australske trykluftdistributør Compressors Australia Pty Ltd med aktiviteter i Brisbane og Melbourne er blevet en del af koncernen, og Philippe Ernens, Business Area President Compressor Technique, udtalte: 'This acquisition is a good addition to the Group which will enhance our service offering to current and future customers in Australia'.
items.source: Atlas Copco AB, pressemeddelelse; citat af Philippe Ernens, Business Area President Compressor Technique
